speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The combination of prematurity (born <32 weeks), respiratory distress, and physical exam findings like tachypnea, retractions, nasal flaring, and cyanosis is highly suggestive of Respiratory Distress Syndrome due to surfactant deficiency. The normal blood work further supports a primary lung issue rather than sepsis.
